description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Ruthless Technomancer with haste.
When the Ruthless Technomancer token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Kiki-Jiki and create two Treasure tokens,
When Kiki-Jiki dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel with flying and a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Ruthless Technomancer with haste.
When the Ruthless Technomancer token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Kiki-Jiki and create three Treasure tokens,
Activate thee Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Activate a Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing two Treasures, returning Kiki-Jiki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
